baseline_models.mechanism: The first-person plural anticipates harm from a marked occurrence: the day is not a neutral date but a severe event whose grimness and trouble spread under the Rabb's authority.

activation_trace.role: Fearful anticipation of harm makes نَخَافُ a sign-responsive expectation rather than an unconditioned mood.
Lordship, ownership, and authority locate the feared event within the Rabb's governing power.
The event-day or severe occasion turns يَوْمًا from calendar time into a decisive happening.
The harsh grim day supplies the event's distressing quality directly.
A harsh day with spreading trouble intensifies severity into an evil that propagates.

changed_reading.before: A generic statement that the speakers are afraid of a bad day.
changed_reading.after: A collective, sign-responsive anticipation of a concrete severe occurrence whose trouble can spread under the Rabb's authority.

baseline_models.mechanism: The day is given a contracting face while قَمْطَرِيرًا adds piling and drawing-together: affective grimness becomes a spatial pressure in which distress gathers and the horizon tightens.

activation_trace.role: The severe event-day provides the temporal body to which the following images attach.
Facial frowning from distress or anger personifies the day through visible contraction.
Piling up and drawing together converts the facial contraction into accumulated spatial pressure.

changed_reading.before: عَبُوسًا and قَمْطَرِيرًا are two interchangeable intensifiers of severity.
changed_reading.after: The day enacts severity: it presents a contracted face while its harms gather and draw tight around those within it.

baseline_models.mechanism: A branch-distant material reading joins fear as diminution with a waterskin tied shut: the feared day depletes remaining security while closing an outlet through which pressure or relief could pass.

activation_trace.role: Diminishing by taking away supplies an exploratory depletion image behind the focus fear.
Tying a waterskin closed supplies a concrete closure mechanism for قَمْطَرِيرًا.

changed_reading.before: The verse names an abstractly terrifying future.
changed_reading.after: The future is materially imagined as a closed, depleting pressure from which ordinary release has been tied off.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prior coordination of complete vow-fulfillment, self-obligation, and fear makes the focus fear operational: warning awakens precaution, and precaution is expressed as fidelity carried through without deficiency.

activation_trace.role: Anticipation of harm anchors the revised model in نَخَافُ.
The severe event-day is the object kept practically in view.
Completion without deficiency makes fulfillment the behavioral shape paired with fear.
Binding oneself to what was not already obligatory supplies the covenantal commitment that fear helps sustain.
The repeated fearful anticipation explicitly joins the focus emotion to vow-fulfillment.

structural_cues: 76:7 coordinates fulfilling the vow and fearing the day in one subject sequence; 76:8 then continues with feeding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies completion, voluntary self-binding, and repeated fear; I infer that fear energizes fidelity rather than merely accompanying it. A live alternative is that 76:7 lists independent virtues without a directional causal arrow.

changed_reading.before: Fear is an inward reaction to an approaching severe event.
changed_reading.after: Fear is vigilant covenantal attention that carries self-imposed obligations through to completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speakers relinquish food to others despite heart-level attachment and explicitly refuse reciprocal compensation; their following confession of fear therefore reads as an outward ethical engine that breaks a closed exchange economy.

activation_trace.role: Anticipated harm anchors the motive in the focus verb rather than in a free-standing charity theme.
Feeding another supplies the concrete transfer through which fear becomes social action.
Love clinging to the heart makes the transfer costly rather than surplus disposal.
Reciprocating an act with its return is explicitly refused, defining the feeding as nonreciprocal.

structural_cues: The direct speech runs from 'we feed you' and 'we desire no recompense' in 76:9 to 'we fear' in 76:10, after naming the poor person, orphan, and captive in 76:8.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies costly feeding, rejected reciprocity, and adjacent first-person fear speech; I infer that fear redirects attachment into one-way care. Alternatively, feeding and fear may be parallel demonstrations of sincerity rather than a strict motivational chain.

changed_reading.before: The speakers fear primarily for their own future safety.
changed_reading.after: Their fear opens present resources toward vulnerable others without demanding repayment, so eschatological attention produces nonreciprocal care.

context_deltas.mechanism: A three-ayah facial sequence emerges: action is directed to God's face, the day presents a frown, and God causes the speakers to encounter radiance. The threatening face is crossed and answered by a bestowed counter-face.

activation_trace.role: Facial contraction anchors the proposed face sequence directly in عَبُوسًا.
The face and what fronts the actor establish the orientation immediately before the frowning day.
What a person is made to encounter, whether good or evil, supplies the directional handoff from threat to gift.
Radiant freshness supplies the positive visible state that reverses the focus frown.

structural_cues: 76:9, 76:10, and 76:11 place face-orientation, the frowning day, and encountered radiance in immediate succession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies face-direction, a facial-frown branch, encounter, and radiance; I infer a deliberate facial polarity across the sequence. Radiance could instead denote general freshness rather than a specifically facial reversal.

changed_reading.before: Calling the day frowning is a self-contained anthropomorphic intensifier.
changed_reading.after: The frowning day is the negative middle face in a sequence that begins with orientation to God's face and ends with radiance bestowed on the speakers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah answers anticipated harm with active shielding: fear identifies a real spreading danger, yet the danger is bounded because God interposes protection from that very day's evil.

activation_trace.role: Expectation of harm supplies the danger to which protection responds.
Spreading trouble specifies why a shield is required.
Driving away harm by a protective barrier supplies the immediate answer to the focus fear.

structural_cues: 76:11 begins with فَوَقَىٰهُمُ, immediately reidentifies 'that day,' and names its evil after the fear statement of 76:10.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fear followed by fā-marked protection from the same day's evil; I infer an answered precaution in which fear's vigilance is met by shielding. The fā can also mark narrative consequence without making fear itself causative.

changed_reading.before: Fear faces an unbounded terror whose outcome remains open.
changed_reading.after: Fear is proportionate awareness of real harm, but the feared day is not ultimate: its evil can be intercepted by protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later contrast between preferring the immediate and abandoning a heavy day identifies the focus fear as temporal discipline: the speakers keep deferred consequence in the active decision horizon instead of placing it behind present desire.

activation_trace.role: Anticipation makes a not-yet-present harm behaviorally present.
The severe event-day is the deferred occurrence held in view.
Haste and bringing something forward define the rival preference for the immediate.
Leaving a thing supplies the act of dropping the future day from practical concern.
Weight opposed to lightness recasts the focus grimness as a consequence too substantial to ignore.

structural_cues: 76:27 contrasts loving the immediate with leaving behind a heavy day; the focus speakers enact the inverse by fearing a future day while choosing costly present action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate preference, abandonment, and a heavy day; I infer that focus fear functions as disciplined future-attention. A live alternative is that 76:27 diagnoses a separate rejecting group without defining the internal operation of the speakers' fear.

changed_reading.before: Fear is chiefly an intensity of emotion about the future.
changed_reading.after: Fear is a temporal practice that refuses presentism by keeping deferred moral weight inside current choice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same Rabb named inside the fear relation later gives the protected people drink. Lordship therefore retains judgment while also taking the form of nurture, provision, and completion; warning and refreshment belong to one formative relation.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion keep a formative sense available within رَبِّنَا.
Giving drink concretizes the care supplied by the same Rabb after protection.
The repeated Rabb links the provider of drink to the focus relation of fear and formation.

structural_cues: The surah later pairs Rabb with giving a purifying drink in 76:21, with judgment in 76:24, and with the chosen path in 76:29.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated title, its nurture branch, and the Rabb's act of giving drink; I infer one pedagogical relation spanning warning and provision. The authority branch remains live, and the recurrence need not make the severe day itself gentle.

changed_reading.before: 'Our Rabb' primarily identifies the sovereign source of the feared day.
changed_reading.after: The feared day belongs within a formative Rabb-subject relation whose authority warns, protects, and eventually provides, rather than within alien terror.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the diminution branch belongs most naturally to a derived use of the fear root, not a direct gloss of نَخَافُ. It remains anchored in the packet's supplied خ و ف branch and in the adjacent costly, unrepaid feeding sequence. Downstream prose should mark it as an ethical material analogy, not translate the focus verb as 'we diminish.'

activation_trace.role: Diminishing by taking away opens a branch-distant economic image within the focus fear.
Feeding another is the concrete voluntary reduction of what the speakers hold.
Heart-clinging love establishes that what is relinquished is valued.
Refused recompense prevents the present reduction from being restored by exchange.

changed_reading.before: Fear seeks to preserve the self and its goods from loss.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the speakers accept present self-diminishment through unrepaid giving rather than organize life around avoiding every loss before a destructive day.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the concrete waterskin-closure branch of ق م ط ر rather than its direct severe-day branch. It remains anchored in قَمْطَرِيرًا and gains a coherent whole-surah contrast from springs being burst open and drink being given. Downstream prose should present a hydraulic analogy of constriction versus circulation, never a replacement lexical gloss.

activation_trace.role: A waterskin tied closed gives the feared day a concrete image of blocked release.
Wide splitting and outflow supplies the first counter-image of deliberately opened circulation.
Giving drink completes the counter-image in which withheld flow becomes received refreshment.

changed_reading.before: قَمْطَرِيرًا only raises the degree of the day's harshness.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the feared day is a sealed pressure, while the righteous trajectory is figured by opening springs and receiving freely circulating drink.

strongest_changes: Fear changes from inward dread into vigilant fulfillment of self-binding commitments.
The adjacent feeding and refusal of recompense make fear an engine of costly, nonreciprocal care.
The frowning day becomes the negative middle of a face-to-radiance reversal across 76:9-11.
Immediate protection bounds the feared evil, while 76:27 recasts fear as resistance to present-minded neglect.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package did not merely intensify the focus threat. It made fear functional across covenantal, social, facial, protective, temporal, and nurturing mechanisms, while the rare ق م ط ر branches preserved exploratory material readings of contraction and sealed flow.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrow from fear to feeding may be explanatory rhetoric rather than a strict motivational sequence.
The face-to-radiance reversal is structurally tight, but نَضْرَةً may denote general freshness rather than facial appearance alone.
The diminution and waterskin-closure readings are intentionally branch-distant and should remain qualified analogies.
